task.title: Add compact elapsed-duration formatter utility for logs

issue.title: Add compact elapsed-duration formatter utility for logs
issue.body:
Add a small, self-contained utility in `Factory.Core` that formats a `TimeSpan` as a compact human-readable string for structured logging (e.g. `45s`, `2m 15s`, `1h 4m`) — something `ProcessRunner` or step logging could use instead of the raw `TimeSpan` default format. Keep it to one small static class/method plus unit tests in the matching test project; no other files should need to change. Follow AGENTS.md conventions (small cohesive class, explicit naming, no speculative abstraction).

This task is queued to exercise the live second-agent review pipeline end-to-end (SF-712); a second agent will automatically review this change after implementation, no action needed from the implementing agent regarding review.
